proposition: The explicitly supplied D-H/A tuple, in a supported separately named chemical class pair, satisfies the reviewed directional geometric candidate predicate. Not proof of an energetically favorable hydrogen bond.

geometry.acceptorDirectionality: Measure H-A-X and D-A-X for every authoritative directly bonded heavy antecedent X; no qualifying window, inferred lone pair or hybridization direction is proposed.

domain: 100 explicitly listed class pairs, using 10 existing donor role domains and 10 acceptor contexts. Generic pyridinium-NH pairs excluded. No water, sulfur, carboxylate, organic-F, proton-sharing or intracomponent contact expansion.
geometryValidity: Finite common-frame supplied coordinates, distinct mapped D/H/A identities; explicit authoritative single D-H bond; nonzero D-H, H-A and D-A vectors. Degeneracy is unavailable, not zero-angle evidence. No physical lower-distance threshold invented.
scope: Only explicitly selected different authoritative components with no conflicting cross-component covalent assertion. No residue naming or AD4 label as role authority. All correspondence alternatives and explicit donor H atoms preserved; no best-H/one-bond pruning.
negativeMeaning: No tuple satisfying this exact class-pair predicate within the requested complete scope. Never absence of all hydrogen bonding, no donor/acceptor potential, or absence of favorable interactions.
negativeRequirements: complete applicable B00/B01/P03 source-state and correspondence coverage
exact donor class and acceptor context established
all relevant explicit donor H atoms present and mapped; authoritative H count reconciled
exhaustive selected donor-H/acceptor enumeration without truncation
finite nondegenerate measurements for every applicable tuple
no conflicting input assertion; preserved alternatives assessed independently
all pair-specific prerequisites complete; unsupported classes never counted as evaluated negatives
positiveCoverage: Complete candidate-local role/state/explicit-H/coordinate proof and both numerical criteria; a positive never establishes complete search coverage.

assessmentStates.SUPPORTED_PRESENT: At least one fully attributable qualifying tuple; retain all qualifying tuples and unresolved alternatives.
assessmentStates.ABSENT_FALSE: Every applicable tuple demonstrably evaluated and none passes; exact supported pair scope only.
assessmentStates.UNKNOWN_INCONCLUSIVE: Missing H, incomplete state/search/mapping, conflicting assertions or geometry.
assessmentStates.UNSUPPORTED: Class/domain or required representation outside reviewed support.
assessmentStates.FAILED: Attributed execution/perception failure; preserve input evidence.
assessmentStates.NOT_EVALUATED: Not run or not scientifically approved; research artifacts never authorize evaluation.

scientificBasis: Operational precedent: pinned ProLIF HBAcceptor and SingleAngle. Primary ProLIF paper explicitly describes threshold disagreement. These values are not calibrated class-specific optima. The proposal consciously reuses an established screen while keeping each chemistry pair separately reviewable.
legacy: ATHENA.HBOND.DIRECTIONAL/1.0.0/athena.scientific/2 remains byte-identical; no aliases or default migration. Legacy amine witnesses remain UNKNOWN_INCONCLUSIVE.
review: No authorized review, expiry, implementation receipt or QUALIFIED status is created. Accepting this is an explicit operational scientific-definition decision, not evidence of a universal hydrogen-bond cutoff.
